answer.answer: The English and Japanese versions conflict. The English says the 10% service charge applies to all lunch orders, while the Japanese original says it applies only to lunch customers who order a course. The page notes translations are automatic and advises checking with the restaurant.

citations.text: (A 10% service charge will be added to all lunch orders.)
（ランチ利用時はコースご注文のお客様のみサービス料10％を頂戴しております）
Please check with the restaurant for accurate information.
